notes.title: Postponing the release date of SHOOT. KILL. REPEAT. !
notes.notes:
I have to inform you that today is February 20, 2024, the game SHOOT. KILL. REPEAT. It won't work! The final release date is now February 29, 2024.
The transfer occurred due to technical malfunctions in the mechanics of working with equipment, and other problems. The game should now be released in its full version, along with a cooperative mode and a full arsenal.
I hope you enjoy the game!
Sincerely, Pavel Repin (Repin Develop)!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2219260/SHOOT_KILL_REPEAT/

notes.title: THE ANNOUNCEMENT OF THE RELEASE OF SHOOT. KILL. REPEAT.
notes.notes:
The game will be released tomorrow, February 20, 2024. SHOOT. KILL. REPEAT. on the Steam platform as downloadable content for the Pavel Repin Collection. The release will include only a single survival mode. A cooperative game mode and an expanded arsenal will be added in the update on February 29, 2024.
